title: Business rule
description: A plain-language rule with a severity, a scope and a safe data condition evaluated against the process data.

choices.label: Info — recorded in the audit trail
At every step of the process

fields.label: Applies only when (all must hold; empty for always)
fields.help: One condition per line: path operator value. Operators: equals, notEquals, in, notIn, contains, gt, gte, lt, lte, matches (wildcards * and ?), present, missing. Put length after the path to compare a count.

fields.label: Requirement conditions (path operator value)
fields.help: For example checks.typecheck equals "passed". A line written as all(...), any(...) or not(...) is a nested condition kept from the JSON while it is unchanged.
